adversary_breaks.expected: Per-receipt verdicts: an already-consumed receipt replays its durable verdict (result_recorded/consumed); a receipt bound to a different approved lineage is judged against THAT lineage; a receipt under a withdrawn lineage is a grant_revoked HOLD; a not_chargeable abstention is recorded. Withdrawal of the active release must never make already-consumed offline receipts unreportable (the device cannot reconcile them and the message 'No rating was counted' is false for a consumed ticket).
adversary_breaks.observed: HTTP 409 {"error":{"code":"access.release_not_authorized","message":"Validated ratings are not available right now. No rating was counted."},"release":{"status":"ineligible","reasonCode":"withdrawn"}} for all three cases; settle_offline_receipt is never called (VERIFIED: attack_head_final.log lines 17-27, 498-528). Root cause INFERRED from index.ts reconcileOfflineReceipts: chargeableReleaseAdmission() runs once for the batch and returns releaseNotAuthorized() on 'ineligible' BEFORE per-receipt replay / offlineReceiptReleaseLineage(); the per-grant lineage logic (grant_revoked / evidence_ambiguous holds) is only reachable while the active policy is admitted.

adversary_breaks.title: Withdrawing the CURRENT active release policy refuses the whole /v1/offline/receipts batch with 409 access.release_not_authorized before any receipt is judged — replays of already-consumed receipts, receipts whose grant names a different still-approved lineage, and not_chargeable abstentions are all turned away with 'No rating was counted' instead of reaching durable reconciliation

adversary_breaks.expected: A grant that verifies at the instant it was live (exp-1 precedes the retirement, so the old key was the ACTIVE key then) must verify; the receipt settles and consumes exactly once. Instead the receipt is frozen as a durable hold that keeps the ticket reserved forever (no code path un-holds it), so every user whose device stayed offline across a rotation loses the rating they already executed. Same receipt on the un-rotated ring settles (control), proving the evidence is complete.
adversary_breaks.observed: A3 control: settled. After rotation (previous key still inside its overlap): delivery=held, reconciliation.status=reconciliation_required, reasonCode=evidence_ambiguous, financialDisposition=reserved, and settle_offline_receipt was called with p_hold_reason='evidence_ambiguous' (durable). A3c (grant signed 5 min after retirement, inside the 15-min grace the ring honours, delivered after overlapEndsAt) is likewise held. A3b (old-key grant still inside its lease) settles — so only EXPIRED old-key grants are stranded. VERIFIED: attack_head_final.log lines 54-84, 558-574. Root cause INFERRED: offlineSignature.ts verifyOfflineExecutionGrant L579-585 (retired.retiredAtEpochSeconds > context.nowEpochSeconds + GRACE ⇒ retired_key) combined with index.ts offlineGrantVerificationInstant() (min(now, exp-1)).

adversary_breaks.title: Routine signing-key rotation permanently HOLDs (evidence_ambiguous, durable, ticket reserved) the delayed receipt of an old-key grant that EXPIRED before the rotation — the exact delayed-consumption case the package exists for — because offlineGrantVerificationInstant() back-dates verification to exp-1, and the ring's previous-key check then sees retiredAt > instant + grace and throws retired_key

adversary_breaks.expected: delivery=held, status=reconciliation_required with an ambiguity/conflict reason (evidence_ambiguous or operation_conflict), ticket kept reserved — a receipt that says 'nothing to charge' beside an output that says 'scored rating delivered' is ambiguous commitment and must HOLD, not become a permanent 'recorded' verdict that the device treats as reconciled.

adversary_breaks.title: settle_offline_receipt() records a not_chargeable receipt whose delivered output claims resultKind='scored' as delivery=settled / status=result_recorded (durable) instead of HOLDing contradictory evidence — the mirror case (chargeable receipt + abstention output) is held, so the durable ledger accepts an internally inconsistent receipt/output pair

adversary_nonblocking_fix_if_crash_or_ch.expected: Corrupt/unknown SERVER state must not become a durable decision (the implementer's own summary: 'transport failure → 503, never a durable decision on missing data'); an integrity failure of the authority row is a server fault and should answer 503 (or a non-durable pending) so the identical redelivery settles once the row is repaired. The receipt's own evidence is complete — only the server's copy of the release policy is corrupt.
adversary_nonblocking_fix_if_crash_or_ch.observed: HTTP 200, delivery=held, reconciliation_required, evidence_ambiguous, financialDisposition=reserved, durable stand-in holds the receipt (VERIFIED: attack_head_final.log line 28, 543). Root cause INFERRED: index.ts offlineReceiptReleaseLineage catches ReleasePolicyError failure==='integrity' and sets policy=null → evidence_ambiguous, while every other lineage-read failure is thrown → 503.
